title: Mann-Whitney U Test
exactchk: Use Exact p-value (small samples, no ties)

help.title: Mann-Whitney U Test
help.body:
Description
Non-parametric test comparing the distribution of a continuous/ordinal response between exactly two independent groups. This is the rank-based counterpart of the independent-samples t-test and is used when normality cannot be assumed.

Requirements
• Grouping variable must have exactly 2 levels present in the data.
• Base R's exact p-value is only valid when there are no tied ranks. If "Use Exact p-value" is checked and ties are present, this dialog automatically uses the coin package's tie-corrected exact test instead of silently falling back to a normal approximation. If the coin package is not installed (or the tie-corrected test fails for any reason), it falls back to the normal approximation as before, with a note in the output.

R function used: stats::wilcox.test() (and coin::wilcox_test() when ties require a tie-corrected exact test)
R Packages required: stats (base R); coin (optional — only needed for exact p-values with tied data)
